- B and C have four peaks – wrong.
- E has the middle peak lower than the side peaks – wrong (the middle valley of the cut was the deepest, so the middle peak must be the tallest).
- D has three peaks with the tallest peak in the middle, shallow valleys between, and low ends – this matches the inverse of the cut edge.
